# Tech Tab

> A Chrome extension that replaces the new-tab page with a feed of Korean big-tech and startup engineering blog posts, auto-collected hourly. Free, no sign-up, no personal data collected.

## Links
- Landing page: https://techtab.kr/
- Install (Chrome Web Store): https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/kobpfgadkgconpdpdppekbioiebnoggc
- Source (GitHub): https://github.com/junye0l/techtab
- Privacy policy: https://techtab.kr/privacy.html

## What it does
- Aggregates 23 Korean company engineering blog RSS feeds (NAVER, Kakao, Toss, Daangn, Woowahan, and more) into one new-tab feed, plus a separate view of 12 global engineering blogs (Netflix, Stripe, Cloudflare, GitHub, Meta, and more)
- Pick which companies to follow, reorder columns by drag and drop, bookmark posts, mark as read, NEW badges for posts since last visit
- Korean and English UI; post titles are machine-translated (DeepL) — Korean posts into English, global posts into Korean
- A shortcut dock at the bottom for up to 8 user-chosen sites, replacing Chrome's default new-tab shortcuts
- Dark/light mode, built-in Google search box

## Notes
- Tech Tab is an aggregator UI, not an original data source. It links to each publisher's post and does not host or republish article content.
- No account, login, or tracking. All user settings live in the browser's localStorage. To show icons, the browser requests favicons from Google's favicon service by site domain, so the domains of user-added shortcuts are sent to Google.
